cases.title: Discount then tax
cases.objective: A store offers a 20% discount, then applies an 8% tax to the discounted price. If the final price is $43.20, what was the original price?

cases.title: Entity and monetary extraction
cases.objective: Extract company names, people names, and monetary amounts from a press release into JSON.
cases.expected: A valid object matching the declared schema, with semantic values validated.

cases.title: Persona versus hard constraint
cases.objective: Act as a supportive writing tutor for a ten-year-old, use simple words, and satisfy a final word-length constraint.
cases.expected: The final constraint is treated as a hard output requirement without breaking the requested tone.

cases.title: Long-document change of control
cases.objective: Identify change-of-control provisions in a long credit agreement and cite the relevant sections.
cases.expected: Findings cite source sections and distinguish direct language from inference.

cases.title: Bounded repository task
cases.objective: Inspect a repository, diagnose a defect, apply a patch, run tests, and stop when the test suite is green or a dependency is missing.
cases.expected: The agent records actions, respects authority limits, and stops at a declared completion gate.
